fullContent:
Hemabhraka Sindura Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17th edition, 406 – 407. 
 Introduction 
 Hemabhraka Sindura Rasa is one of the effective ayurvedic formulation that is known to contain good properties of minerals and herbs. This formulation is known to treat problems related with vata dosha, brain and heart. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Abhrak bhsama – calcined mica 
 Ras sindoor 
 Swarna bhsama – calcined gold 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients in equal parts and put in mortar pestle. 
 Now crush the ingredients in it with juice of ginger and dry after that. 
 Dose 
 125 mg, two times a day, with honey. 
 Indications 
 
 Tuberculosis 
 Skin disorders 
 Weakness in muscle tissues 
 Heart weakness 
 Vata related disorders 
 Mental disorders 
 Anemia 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
